steps.text: 2. The system loads the tour details for the language; a route or zone that is not configured is generated. E4.

exceptions.text: E4. The tour cannot be loaded → an error message and a retry button.

steps.text: 3. The system asks for location permission and shows the map with the current position, the places and the route. E1, E2.

exceptions.text: E1. No location permission → "No location permission yet…", suggests enabling the permission or switching to remote listening.
E2. Weak GPS (accuracy > 50 m or no new position for 12 seconds) → weak signal warning; places can still be picked manually.

steps.text: 5. The system compares the position with the trigger zones on the device itself (no server call while moving).
6. The Tourist enters the trigger zone of a place.
7. The system plays the place's recorded audio automatically; if there is none, it reads the description with the device's voice; it records a listen (UC#17). A1, A2, E3.

exceptions.text: E3. Broken audio file → read the description with the device's voice; if that fails, show only the text.

steps.text: 8. The system shows the place info panel: text and photos.
9. The Tourist enters a direction audio zone.
10. The system plays the directions when no place audio is playing.
11. The system shows the "Next stop" suggestion for the next place.
12. The Tourist uses the controls: play / pause, seek ±15 seconds, previous / next place, change language. A3.
13. The Tourist reaches the last place. A4.
14. The system records a completion and shows the end dialog with a "Rate the tour" button (UC#05).

exceptions.text: E5. Automatic translation fails: too many requests (429), AI unavailable (503) or the author has turned off automatic translation (403) → keep the current language.
E6. The device has no voice for the language → reports the missing voice and still shows the text.

steps: A1. Several zones overlap: the system plays the place with the highest priority.
A2. Entering another place's zone while audio is playing: a new place with higher priority interrupts and plays at once; with lower or equal priority it waits until the current audio ends.
A3. Pick a place manually: tap a place in the list to listen at once.
A4. Progress is saved on the device (localStorage): reopening the tour shows "You have listened to x/n places" and lets the Tourist continue.
A5.1. The Tourist chooses the "Listen remotely" mode.
A5.2. The system stops GPS tracking and shows the place list.
A5.3. The Tourist picks the place to listen to.
A5.4. The system plays the place's audio as in steps 7 – 8.
A6. Report a violating tour right from the player (UC#06).

A7. Request automatic translation into a language the author has not enabled (if the author allows it): the system translates with AI once, stores it and adds the "Automatic translation" label with a "View original" button. E5.
